name: Ishida Kanami-san no Yuuutsu
original_name: 石田佳奈美さんの憂鬱
source:
Kanako Ishida didn't go straight home and got locked up in the public lavatory by a strange man.
Restraint by the handcuff, she could not resist the violation!
